notice: Snapshot of official store documentation as read on the 'checked' date. Stores change these rules. Re-verify against the 'sources' URLs before every release and update this file (or pass an override file with --profiles) when anything differs.

phone.label: Phone screenshots

recommended.why: Promotion eligibility (recommendation formats): 4+ screenshots, at least 1080 px, 9:16 or 16:9.

manual_checks: Show the real app experience; prioritize UI in the first three screenshots.
Tagline/text covers no more than ~20% of the image.
No ranking, price, promo or call-to-action text (e.g. 'Best', '#1', 'Free', 'Sale', 'Download now').
Clean status bar: no notifications or carrier name; full battery/Wi-Fi/signal.
No device-holding hands.
Alt text per screenshot, 140 characters or fewer.

tablet-7-inch.label: 7-inch tablet screenshots
tablet-7-inch.notes: Official sources disagree: the Play help article says 16:9 or 9:16 and gives both 1,080-7,680 px and a general 3,840 px max; the Android CLI screenshot guide captures tablets at 2560x1600 (16:10). 1920x1080 / 1080x1920 satisfies every source; 16:10 is accepted here with a note.
manual_checks: Avoid extra text near edges that may be cut off.
Alt text per screenshot, 140 characters or fewer.

tablet-10-inch.label: 10-inch tablet screenshots
tablet-10-inch.notes: Same source disagreement as tablet-7-inch (16:9/9:16 vs 16:10).
manual_checks: Avoid extra text near edges that may be cut off.
Alt text per screenshot, 140 characters or fewer.

chromebook.label: Chromebook screenshots
chromebook.notes: developer.android.com screenshot page: exact 16:9 (1,920-7,680 px wide) or 9:16 (1,080-4,320 px wide), 4-8 screenshots.

foldable.label: Foldable screenshots

recommended.why: Android CLI capture sizes for foldable_1_1 / foldable_4_3 profiles.

foldable.notes: 1:1 or 4:3 for the inner display, 10:16 for the outer display. Capture with adb screencap -d <display-id>.

tv.label: Android TV / Google TV screenshots

recommended.why: LaunchFrame default. Official pages checked did not state TV screenshot dimensions; 16:9 matches the TV display.

tv.notes: Part of the Google Play listing (device-specific TV section), not a separate store. Quality guideline TV-G4 asks for at least one unaltered, high-resolution screenshot of the current TV experience.
manual_checks: At least one screenshot is an unaltered capture of the TV UI (TV-G4).

tv-banner.label: TV banner (store)
tv-banner.notes: Required for Android TV apps. Distinct from the 320x180 launcher banner inside the APK.

wear-os.label: Wear OS screenshots
wear-os.notes: Max count of 8 is the general per-device-type limit; no Wear-specific maximum was found.
manual_checks: App interface only: no device frames, no added text, no backgrounds.
No transparency or circular masking.

automotive.label: Android Automotive OS screenshots
automotive.notes: Required for non-parked app categories. If provided: at least 2 portrait (800x1280) and 2 landscape (1024x768). Generic system UI only.
manual_checks: Generic emulator system UI; no vehicle- or OEM-specific UI.

feature-graphic.label: Feature graphic
manual_checks: Key content centered; nothing important in the edge cutoff zones.
Avoid a pure white, black or dark-gray ground.
No device mockups, store badges, or third-party trademarks.
Don't simply repeat the app icon.
Alt text, 140 characters or fewer.

app-icon.label: Hi-res app icon
app-icon.notes: 32-bit PNG. Must follow Google Play icon design specifications; no ranking/price/category badges.

iphone.label: iPhone screenshots (large display class)

recommended.why: Largest current class; App Store Connect scales it down for smaller iPhones.

iphone.notes: Apple requires the large class (Dynamic Island large or Face ID large) when the app runs on iPhone. File size is not specified by Apple and is not checked.
manual_checks: No alpha/transparency (checked) and no misleading UI.
Check whether the current App Store Connect page now requires additional iPhone classes.

iphone-6.1.label: iPhone screenshots (medium display class, optional)
iphone-6.1.notes: Optional; falls back to scaled large-class screenshots.

iphone-duo-outer.label: iPhone Duo outer display
iphone-duo-outer.notes: App Store Connect states this becomes required from April 2027 for apps built with the iOS 27.1 SDK or later. Verify before relying on it.

ipad.label: iPad screenshots (13-inch class)
ipad.notes: Required if the app runs on iPad. Smaller iPad classes are scaled from it.

apple-tv.label: Apple TV (tvOS) screenshots
apple-tv.notes: Apple TV is part of App Store Connect (tvOS platform of the same app record or a separate tvOS app).

apple-watch.label: Apple Watch screenshots
apple-watch.notes: Use one watch size consistently across all localizations.

fire-tablet.label: Fire Tablet screenshots
fire-tablet.notes: Landscape or portrait. Amazon states no alpha rule or file-size limit for tablet screenshots; LaunchFrame exports them opaque anyway.

fire-tablet-icons.label: Fire Tablet icons (small 114x114 + large 512x512)
fire-tablet-icons.notes: Do not upscale the small icon; export each size from the source artwork.

fire-tablet-promo.label: Fire Tablet promotional image (optional)
manual_checks: Must not be a screenshot.
Legible at 300x146 px.
Text at least 50 px from every edge.

fire-tv-icon.label: Fire TV app icon
manual_checks: Main subject inside the central 882x448 safe zone.

fire-tv-background.label: Fire TV background image
manual_checks: Main subject inside the 1214x830 safe area, preferably on the right.
No embedded logos or titles.
